text.title: VUI Conversation Design Decision Tree
text.summary: Routes on whether the channel is actually speech, whether the flow fills slots or only speaks, and whether any slot feeds an irreversible action — separating a chat flow and an announcement script from a full slot-filling dialog spec.

decision-tree.root-question: Does the interface receive speech and speak its replies, or is it typed input with rendered text replies?

branch.when: typed input, rendered text output, no speech recognition and no text-to-speech

conclusion.verdict: skip; there is no recognition confidence, no endpoint timeout and nothing that must survive being heard rather than seen — design it as chat

branch.when: speech in and audio out — IVR, voice assistant, in-car, or a multimodal surface with a voice path
branch.question: Does the flow collect values from the user, or only speak back to them?

branch.when: output only — announcements, status readouts, no value the user has to supply

conclusion.verdict: apply the prompt-copy subset only; spoken text with its class labelled, no URLs or sight-dependent punctuation, and an SSML say-as on every identifier, code, date, ordinal, phone number or currency amount

branch.when: the flow fills slots from what the user says
branch.question: Does any slot feed an irreversible or costly action, and where do the sample utterances come from?

branch.when: at least one slot feeds payment, transfer, cancellation, deletion or dispatch

conclusion.verdict: apply the full methodology, and make explicit confirmation mandatory on those slots regardless of recognition confidence; implicit confirmation is only for low-cost, reversible values

branch.when: all slots are low-cost and reversible, but every sample utterance was written by the designer with no transcribed speech behind it

conclusion.verdict: apply, but block the grammar sign-off; collect call recordings, Wizard-of-Oz sessions or chat logs until real speech is represented in every intent's ten-plus utterances

branch.when: all slots are low-cost and reversible, and transcribed speech is represented in each intent

conclusion.verdict: apply the full methodology; NM1-NM3 and NI1-NI3 as separate escalating branches with separate counters and a max-retry escape, option menus capped at three to four with the hook last, universals recognised in every state
